---
name: Family request
about: Something you'd like the family hub to do differently (no technical detail needed)
title: "[Family] "
labels: family-request
assignees: ''

---

**What were you trying to do?**
For example: "Check who is doing school pickup on Thursday."

**What gets in the way today?**
For example: "I have to open three people's calendars to find it."

**What would make it better?**
Describe it however you like. A sketch or photo of a piece of paper is great.

**How important is this?**
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would make my week easier
- [ ] Bugging me every day

**Screenshot (optional)**
Take a screenshot of the screen you were on and drag it in here.
